subject: Post-call: Stakeholder map & MAP next steps (FinPay)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Stakeholder map & MAP next steps (FinPay)

Thanks Jordan — great to meet the FinPay team today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

1) What we heard (high level)
- Primary use case: real-time risk scoring and fraud explanations in checkout flows (latency SLO < 150ms p95).
- Key workloads: concurrent inference at 250–500 qps during peak, embeddings for semantically searching transaction metadata, and a small reranking flow for flagged transactions.
- Decision criteria: latency, total cost (TCO) at 1M transactions/month, compatibility with internal KMS, and SOC2 evidence.

2) Stakeholders you called out
- Economic buyer: Alicia Parker (VP, Payments) — owns budget and procurement cadence.
- Security/Procurement: Liam O'Connor (Head of Security Ops) — will need SOC2, data flow docs, and encryption-in-transit details.
- Technical champion: Jordan Matthews (you) — owns PoC and integration.

3) Suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones
- Week 1: Share MAP & integration checklist; gather security questionnaire items (owner: FinPay)
- Week 2: RedTeam/POC kick-off; environment access + sample dataset (owner: Redwood & FinPay)
- Week 4: Initial latency + cost benchmarking on representative load; map to Dedicated sizing
- Week 6: Security review & procurement paperwork; target decision meeting

I've attached a first-pass MAP and a one-pager on Redwood dedicated options. Please confirm the stakeholders above and suggest any changes to the timeline. If Alicia prefers, we can schedule a short 30-min call to align on procurement timelines this week.

Next steps for us (internal) — Camila/Rafael: I'll wait to hear back on timelines and any additional contacts so we can draft a commercial outline and SOC evidence packet.

Thanks again — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-v1.xlsx, redwood-product-one-pager.pdf

From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Parker <alicia.parker@finpay.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finpay.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder map & MAP next steps (FinPay)

Thanks Marissa — great summary and appreciated the clear milestones. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed stakeholders: Alicia is the economic buyer and will own budget approval. Liam is the security lead — I'll ask him to complete the standard vendor security questionnaire and share any additional controls required.
- Timeline: Week 1 looks good for the MAP + security questionnaire. Can we push the POC kick-off to the following Monday (week 2) to align with our sprint planning? That would put benchmarking in week 4 as you suggested.
- Data: We'll provide a synthetic sample dataset (PII scrubbed) and an account-level API key for the POC staging environment.

Alicia — looping you in to confirm budget window for July and whether you prefer a separate procurement sync or for us to include you in the technical calls.

Jordan
Head of ML Engineering | FinPay
jordan.matthews@finpay.com

From: Alicia Parker <alicia.parker@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@finpay.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finpay.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder map & MAP next steps (FinPay)

Thanks Jordan and Marissa. July budget window works for us — Alicia here. I prefer a single procurement/security sync with Liam and Jordan present rather than separate calls. Please include procurement's standard T&Cs and any common SSO/KMS integration notes in the MAP so procurement can do a quick pass.

Also — Liam: please flag any SOC2 evidence items we should expect from Redwood so we can prioritize.

Alicia Parker
VP, Payments | FinPay
alicia.parker@finpay.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@finpay.com>, Alicia Parker <alicia.parker@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finpay.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder map & MAP next steps (FinPay)

Appreciate the quick confirmations — I've updated the MAP and attached v1. Highlights of the update:

- Added a procurement checklist section (T&Cs, SSO/KMS notes, SOC2 evidence list).
- Adjusted timeline per Jordan: POC kick-off Monday, June 28 (week 2).
- Owners assigned: FinPay to provide dataset and staging API key; Redwood to deliver POC runbook and initial benchmark template.

Proposed next actions:
- Jordan/Alicia: confirm the POC kickoff attendee list (engineer + security) by EOD Jun 25.
- Liam: if you can share SOC2 evidence requests or start the vendor questionnaire, we'll prioritize turning around those docs.
- We (Redwood) will prepare a short procurement packet (T&Cs + pricing range) and a one-hour benchmarking plan for the POC.

If useful, I've included a quick Drive folder with the MAP, a sample runbook, and our SOC2 summary: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFinPay-MAP

Camila & Rafael — please draft the commercial outline and pricing band for the POC (aim: ballpark numbers by Jun 25). Rafael, can you also pull the SOC2 summary and the KMS integration note so we can include them in the packet?

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
